item.title: Visibility Design and Strategic Reasoning
item.description: Dashboards, feeds and leaderboards decide whom agents think they are playing against; this paper treats that visibility as a design lever and derives how it shapes aggregate behavior.

item.title: The Architecture of Illusion: Network Opacity and Strategic Escalation
item.description: The Connected Minds model: agents reason iteratively but observe a sample biased by their network position, so opacity makes them overestimate others and escalate.
